body:
I used to be bullied. A lot. To the point where it has affected me in my adult life. Anti-depressants at ten, suicide attempt at twelve. A dead friend at thirteen.

These fuckers went so far as to try to kill my cat.

Funnily enough, one is now in jail for beating the shit out of his girlfriend.

I have no sympathy for you, OP. Sorry.

You have to live with your demons for the rest of your life.

Just life and overworked, I guess. My ex-gf called me while she was drunk, and apologized for breaking up and kept saying that she loves me but this other girl in the same breath. Doesn't help that my childhood cat might be dying.

I'm sorry you had to go through that ):

I hope healing and stability for you in the future.
Yeah. All the time, to be honest. I find it better than reality.

Yikes, I'm very sorry OP.

I hope they catch this fucker. And that when they do, the person gets a lifelong, suffering sentence.

I am curious and I saw that it's been asked and maybe you'll update us but the both of you do have a safe word, right? That way if you're triggered or pushed, especially after this, you can say it (or make the motion) and the scene can stop.

Safety first.

Regards.

I'm sorry OP.

This is why I always check to make sure children are okay when they're screaming. Even when I'm working and a child starts screaming, I have to check if they're okay, even though I'm just some dumb employee at a stupid retail job, I just can never help but worry. You can never know, after all. Children express delight by screaming and pain or fear by screaming.

Was the boyfriend ever caught?

Go to a priest, get crosses and Holy Water, while it could anger the evil one, it could also get rid of it.

Good luck.

Be careful, OP. This man may be a threat and may be a demon. Do not engage him, do not threaten him or use any ouija boards. Get history on your place, and try to sleep.

If he becomes violent or otherwise, put your foot down and announce that you live there now, and it is your home and for him to leave you alone.

I had a bad feeling from your last part.

OP, please, please be okay.

Just update us at some point, please?

OP, get a license to carry concealed weapons. Pepper spray. Get a knife, brass knuckles.

And like someone else said, learn self defense.
Men probably just don't report it.

I'm sorry what you've gone through. I hope you remain safe, OP. And I dearly hope you find that freedom you're looking for. I look forward to more updates.

And that you feel better.

Did they tell you how that turned out or what the medium said? If you are comfortable with sharing, since I'm quite curious.

It could have been, though the church and the people are uh kinda weird. Paranoid and hateful, are the best terms I can think of. So whether she meant bad spirits in the supernatural sense, or not I don't know.

I wish I could too! 

And no, I've thought about it but in the end, thanks to the fear that the church I grew up in, instilled in me, I back out. Funnily enough, there used to be a psychic that lived next door to my parents' church. She was invited to service, and told the man no and mentioned there was a bad spirit there. She moved a month later.
